title: Fix signup/login/logout to prevent stale auto-login and ensure data/session is cleared

requirements.text: Fix the signup flow so newly authenticated users can successfully complete signup and then immediately use the app with the correct account (no accidental reuse of a previous user). This includes: (1) ensure engineer signup results in the caller receiving whatever access-control permission is required to call user endpoints (e.g., getCallerUserProfile/listReports/createReport) right after signup, and (2) ensure signup does not leave the app in a state where it keeps showing/using an old user’s data.

quotes: still same issue and now app became vulnerable. no proper signup, always login to old user, still app data not cleared.

acceptanceCriteria: With a never-before-seen Internet Identity principal, after Internet Identity authentication the app shows the Profile Setup screen, signup succeeds, and the user can access the main app without seeing an Unauthorized/session-invalid error loop.
After signup completes, fetching the caller profile succeeds and returns the newly created profile for that principal (not a previous user).
Engineer accounts can create and view their own reports immediately after completing signup (without requiring an admin-only background step).

requirements.text: Fix admin signup credential mismatch and remove insecure client-side admin password validation: align the admin signup password behavior between frontend and backend so admin signup can succeed when valid, and ensure the frontend does not hardcode or validate the admin signup password value locally (it should only require a value and rely on the backend response).
acceptanceCriteria: Admin signup can succeed when the correct admin signup password is provided (as defined/checked by the backend).

The frontend no longer contains a hardcoded admin signup password value comparison for validation; entering any non-empty value is allowed, and incorrect passwords are rejected by the backend with a user-facing error.
When admin signup is attempted with an incorrect password, the user sees a clear English error message and no privileged access is granted.

requirements.text: Ensure logout fully clears client-side authentication state and app data so the next app load does not automatically log into a previous user and does not show stale cached data. Strengthen the existing full logout flow to reliably reset identity/session state and invalidate all cached user-specific UI state across refreshes.

quotes: always login to old user, still app data not cleared.

acceptanceCriteria: After clicking the app’s logout / switch-account action, the app reloads to an unauthenticated state and shows the Login screen (no automatic re-authentication).

After logout, previously viewed user-specific data (e.g., profile/report lists) is not shown again unless the user logs back in; switching to a different Internet Identity results in seeing only the new user’s data.
If the app detects a stale/invalid session state, the user is guided to perform a full logout and the flow results in a clean unauthenticated start state.

requirements.text: Investigate and remediate the reported security vulnerability caused by the current auth/signup/logout behavior, focusing on preventing cross-account data exposure (e.g., a new user seeing an old user’s data, or unintended persistence of authenticated state). Add defensive checks so that UI state, cached queries, and actor bindings cannot leak data across identity changes.
acceptanceCriteria: It is not possible to observe another user’s cached data after switching accounts (even briefly) during login/logout transitions.
Backend endpoints that return user-specific data enforce caller-based access correctly (non-admins cannot access other users’ profiles or reports).
Regression test steps are documented (in code comments or a short internal note) describing how to verify no stale identity/session persists after logout and account switching.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx (immutable paths).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add migration.mo if a state upgrade is strictly required.
nonGoals: Add third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Introduce external databases or backend services beyond the existing single canister.
Add new product features unrelated to authentication/session correctness (e.g., new report types, messaging, notifications).
